text:
maria.ng: Kicking off onboarding for FalconX-7B (v1.0) quantized -> int8. Need a rollout plan covering hosted + dedicated + private. Goals: <=5% quality regression vs FP16 baseline, p95 latency < 120ms at 128 tokens, and canary at 10% for 24h. Who's in?
priya.s: I'm in. Can you paste evals and perf numbers?
ben.k: Quick summary from local runs:
- Eval Rouge-L: baseline FP16 0.82, falconx-int8 0.80 (-2.4%)
- Rerank MRR: baseline 0.71, int8 0.69 (-2.8%)
- Throughput on g5.2x: ~120 req/s; p95 ~95ms (64 tokens), ~150ms (256 tokens)
Note: small variance depending on kv-cache hit rate.
eva: Regression is within threshold but close for a subset of prompts. We should: add prompt-specific regression checks, and a small high-risk canary cohort.
maria.ng: Proposed rollout (high level):
1) Private smoke & perf: dedicated pool (2x GPUs) — 2h
2) Hosted canary: start at 2% -> ramp to 10% over 6h -> 24h steady at 10%
3) Dedicated expand: shift traffic / enable reserved capacity if metrics stable
Fallbacks: auto-route to FP16 variant on quality alert OR sustained latency >200ms for 10m.
ben.k: Eval hooks to add:
- Eval set A (regression detection full set)
- Canary cohort B: 50 high-risk customer-like prompts
- Thresholds: Rouge-L delta <= -3%, MRR delta <= -3%, p95 latency < 200ms
Also log token-level diffs for hallucination detection.
maria.ng: ops-oncall, can you wire SLO checks and alerting runbook for this canary?
ops-oncall: On it. Will add alerts for metric breaches (5m aggregation) and page per runbook. Creating dashboard panels: latency, Rouge-L delta, MRR delta, cost/token.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: falconx-7b-int8 -> hosted/canary v1 (id: ci-78912). Traffic plan: 2% immediate, ramp to 10% over 6h. Safeguards: autoscale disabled, explicit fallback route to falconx-7b-fp16 enabled.
priya.s: QA note: hallucination eval uses fixed seed 42 and beam=5. We'll kick off a run at 2h and 12h into the canary.
ben.k: Quick smoke commands we used locally:
```
rcli deploy --model falconx-7b-int8 --pool dedicated-gpu-2 --smoke --timeout 300
rcli eval --suite canary-cohort --save results/fx7b-int8-$(date +%s).json\```
maria.ng: Add token-cost monitoring and anomaly alert (spike >20% cost/token relative to baseline).
eva: Rollback plan if triggered:
- Cut hosted canary traffic to 0% immediately
- Promote FP16 variant on same route key
- Capture failing prompts + model outputs and open ticket in #prod-bug with samples
- If dedicated pool affected, scale down and disable canary queueing
ben.k: Also: schedule int4 experiment only after int8 has been stable for at least 2 weeks and no major regressions.
maria.ng: I'll run the checklist and post status here. Assigning owners: priya.s -> canary evals, ben.k -> perf & smoke, eva -> quality monitoring, ops-oncall -> alerts/dashboard.
ops-oncall: Alerts and dashboard created: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/fx7b-canary (basic panels live)
deploy-bot: Canary ramp update: now at 5% traffic @2026-04-12T12:00Z
maria.ng: 12:30 smoke OK on dedicated pool. No obvious perf regressions.
priya.s: 14:10 eval results: Rouge-L delta -1.9%, MRR -1.7%, p95 = 110ms for 128 tokens. Passing thresholds. Uploading CSV to /mnt/evals/fx7b-int8-20260412.csv
eva: Good. Keep 24h observation. If nothing flips we can plan dedicated expansion and then private packaging.
maria.ng: After 24h, next steps: dedicated reserved capacity request, update docs with quantization caveats, and schedule postmortem checklist for any prompt failures.
ben.k: Noted. I'll collect the top 20 prompts where token-diff > 0.02 and seed the bug triage.
maria.ng: Thanks everyone — I'll post final go/no-go after 24h obs. :thumbsup:
